title: The Ghost of Glow-A-Lot
logline: When a spooky 'ghost' empties Glow-A-Lot Carnival and eyes the charity pumpkin bank, the Widgeteers find two lousy burglars — and one very sleepy owl.
moral: The thing you're scared of might just need a nap. Charity isn't for taking. Look closer.
tone: Kids 3D Pixar adventure-comedy. Scooby-Doo bones, zero horror.

locations.name: Glow-A-Lot Carnival
locations.note: No plate yet — invent a cozy Pixar autumn carnival, never horror-park.

blocks.text: A cozy autumn carnival glows on the edge of town. A gold-and-purple FERRIS WHEEL turns slow as a lullaby. Fairy lights stitch the midway together. A wooden arch reads GLOW-A-LOT CARNIVAL — FALL FEST. Kids weave past cotton candy and bumper cars. Center stage: a GIANT smiling PUMPKIN PIGGY-BANK on a pedestal, wrapped in string lights. A banner flaps: KINDNESS PUMPKIN — COINS FOR THE PETTING ZOO!
A LITTLE GIRL on her dad's shoulders drops a coin into the slot. The pumpkin RATTLES from somewhere deep inside — too alive for a wooden box. A pale shape flutters past the Ferris wheel and is gone.
(pointing up, whispering)
Did you see that? The Ghost of Glow-A-Lot!
(forcing a laugh)
It's just the wind, sweetheart. ...Right?
A gust. A white sheet-like figure WHOOSHES over the pumpkin and melts into the fog. The calliope hits a sour note. Coins inside the pumpkin clink like little footsteps.

Blue gear-print wallpaper. Captain Spark posters. A basketball under the desk. TANGO, civilian clothes, spins a ball on one finger while a small TABLET on the desk plays the news. He is half-watching. Then he isn't.
(breathless)
...Glow-A-Lot Carnival closed early after guests reported a floating white phantom circling the Kindness Pumpkin. Donations for the petting zoo were left sitting in the open!
Tango stops the ball with both hands. His eyes go dinner-plate wide.
Bravo. Bravo. BRAVO.
He slaps his communicator. BRAVO's face pops up in a tiny holo — already wearing that I-have-a-theory look, glasses catching the desk lamp.
I saw it. Floating white mass. Unexplained rattle. Charity money sitting in the open. That is not a ghost, Tango. That is a problem.
(already grabbing his cap)
Race you to the lab. Loser cleans Pipi's propellers.

scenes.heading: SCENE 03  INT. BRAVO'S SECRET LAB - NIGHT

blocks.text: Chrome panels. Teal strip lights. Two glass SUIT TUBES glow — purple-gold and teal-green. PIPI zips a figure-eight over the work table, visor smiling. Bravo is already at the curved holo-desk. Tango jogs in, basketball abandoned by the stairs.
(bright, chirpy)
Scan complete. One giant pumpkin. Many coins. One very suspicious fog cloud.
(tapping the hologram)
Fog on a clear night? That's not weather. That's a machine.
And I know two guys who love machines that make trouble. Also hats. Very committed to hats.

The suit tubes hiss open. Bravo pulls the green helmet on in one practiced shove. Tango snaps the gold visor down and points finger-guns at Pipi. Pipi finger-guns back with a tiny robot arm. A beat of pure kid-superhero joy.
Widgeteers, roll out!

scenes.heading: SCENE 04  EXT. CARNIVAL MIDWAY / BEHIND POPCORN CART - NIGHT

blocks.text: The midway is empty, lights still on, popcorn still warm. The Kindness Pumpkin waits like a friendly orange moon. Behind a yellow POPCORN CART: CHURRO, smug as a cat in a fedora, and MUFFIN, holding a rope tied to a bedsheet and a dented fog machine labeled SPOOK-O-MATIC 3000.
(whisper-shouting, which is not whispering)
Phase one is working, Muffin. Everyone ran. Now we simply... borrow the pumpkin.
Borrow? Like a library book? Do pumpkins have due dates?
(deadpan)
Yes. Due tonight. In our hideout. With the coins.
Ooooh. Coins can buy so many churros. Wait. That's you. Can they buy muffins?
Focus. I raise the ghost. You roll the pumpkin. A perfect plan.

Churro yanks the fishing line. The bedsheet RISES like a cheap phantom above the pumpkin. Fog belches out, smelling faintly of burnt caramel. The pumpkin RATTLES from inside. Neither of them notices a tiny golden eye blink in the coin slot.
(freezing)
Uh, Churro? Did the pumpkin just... growl?
Pumpkins do not growl. Ghosts growl. Which is us. Which is fake. MOVE.

The Widgeteers sweep in: Tango on the purple JETBIKE, Bravo on the glowing teal SCOOTER, Pipi as a third headlight. An empty ticket booth. A dropped stuffed bear. Spooky the way a birthday party is spooky after everyone goes home.
(trying to be cool, failing a little)
Okay. Not gonna lie. A little spooky.
Stay scientific. Eyes up. Coins first. Ghosts... later. Preferably never.
Fog signature: bargain brand. Stinky.

scenes.heading: SCENE 06  EXT. MIDWAY / KINDNESS PUMPKIN - NIGHT

blocks.text: They approach the pumpkin. Bravo's wrist scanner hums a polite, unimpressed beep. Behind them — we stay on their BACKS — the bedsheet ghost RISES, fog curling around their boots. Tango whirls.
(voice cracking, then dropping two octaves on purpose)
G-g-ghost! I mean. Ghost. Hi. We're professionals.
The sheet snags on a popcorn box. A fishing line CATCHES the light like a spider thread. Bravo pinches it between two fingers, delighted.
That's not ectoplasm. That's fishing line. Twelve-pound test. Very earthly.
And a coupon still stuck to the fog machine.
The 'ghost' panics and dives toward the bumper cars, sheet flapping like bad laundry.

Churro slaps a stolen lever. Bumper cars SPARK awake and start a riderless rumba. The Widgeteers hop the rails. Muffin, wearing the sheet, stumbles into a spinning car and becomes a round white dreidel of regret.
(muffled, spinning)
I am a very dizzy ghost!
Stop narrating, you walnut!

Pipi dives under the control box and YANKS a plug with her little arm. Cars freeze mid-bump. The sheet flies off the empty car and lands on a stuffed prize llama. The crooks are already waddling toward the Hall of Mirrors.
Hall of Mirrors. Of course. Because running in a straight line is too honest.

scenes.heading: SCENE 08  INT. HALL OF MIRRORS - NIGHT

blocks.text: Wacky glass. Hero suits warp into noodle-Bravo and basketball-Tango. Twenty MUFFINS waddle in twenty directions. Pipi paints a teal scan-line across the floor. One trail of popcorn kernels leads to the real one.
Real burglars leave real footprints. Ghosts don't eat popcorn. Also ghosts don't exist.
(scooping a kernel)
This one has butter. Very haunted butter.
They burst out the EXIT into night air. Down the midway, two silhouettes are trying — and failing — to lift a pumpkin the size of a small car.

Churro heaves. Muffin heaves. The pumpkin does not heave. Muffin sits on it to 'push with his sit.' The pedestal TIPS. The Kindness Pumpkin ROLLS — a giant orange boulder thundering down the midway. Coins jingle a panic song.
The library book is escaping!
That is not how libraries work!

Chase. Tracking alongside the pumpkin. Tango bounce-kicks a parked bumper car into a soft stop. Bravo lassos the stem with a prize-booth rope. The pumpkin kisses the Ferris wheel base and STOPS. The bedsheet settles over Muffin like a failed magic trick.
(grabbing the sheet)
Let's see who our phantom really is...
YANK. MUFFIN blinks, beanie crooked, mask askew. CHURRO tries to sneak away with a fistful of spilled coins. Pipi MAGNET-BEEPS. The coins leap into her little tray like trained fish.
It would have worked if the pumpkin wasn't so... pumpkin-y!
You tried to steal donations for the petting zoo.
(genuinely crushed)
I didn't know the zoo was pets. I thought it was... zoo-coins. For snacks.
They hog-tie the crooks to the popcorn cart with stuffed-animal prize strings. A plush llama now guards Churro's fedora. Bravo plants his fists on his hips, satisfied.
No ghosts. Just two very loud, very caught crooks.

scenes.heading: SCENE 10  EXT. KINDNESS PUMPKIN / FERRIS WHEEL - NIGHT

blocks.text: A soft HOOOOOT. A small white figure lifts off the pumpkin lid and drifts, cape fluttering. Everyone freezes. Even Churro. Especially Muffin.
(tiny voice)
Uh, Bravo? You said no ghosts.

Pipi throws a gentle spotlight. The figure lands on the pumpkin's stem. It is HOOT — a tiny white barn owl tangled in a magician's cape from the prize booth, two poked eye-holes making her look like the world's shyest baby ghost.
Lifeform: owl. Mood: shy. Last known address: pumpkin.
Bravo lifts the cape as if it were a blanket. Under the lid: a nest of raffle tickets and the pumpkin's warm night-bulb. Hoot blinks. Bravo blinks back, scientist melted.
She made a nest in the Kindness Pumpkin. The rattle was coins hitting her bedtime.
(soft, grinning)
Aw. The Ghost of Glow-A-Lot was just hungry for a nap.
Hoot hop-hops onto Tango's gold helmet and sits like a feathery siren.
Can we keep her? She can be Ghost... Junior.
We are literally tied to a popcorn cart.
Carnival folks flood back, laughing now. A kind PETTING-ZOO KEEPER lifts Hoot like a cupcake. Kids drop coins again. The pumpkin's painted smile seems, somehow, even friendlier.

The Widgeteers ride the Ferris wheel, city lights below. Pipi matches HOOT in a little loop-the-loop beside the gondola. The midway is alive again. Down below, Muffin and Churro wait for actual police, still wearing a llama.
So the scary thing was a sleepy owl and two guys who can't lift a pumpkin.
Most mysteries are just someone needing help. Or a snack.
(from very far below)
I still need a snack!
They laugh. The wheel carries them up into gold-purple night. Pipi's visor draws a tiny heart. FADE OUT.
THE END
